procedure.KEEP: Action; range 120 feet; V/S/F; rank 7/base 17 RP; concentration up to 60 seconds. Preserve exactly three linked portals appearing in rapid sequence and the Planar tag.
procedure.NEW_topology: Select C01-A: three fixed vertical apertures, each five feet wide and eight feet high, directed A→B→C→A. Front-face entry only; no reverse route, later link selection or six-aperture interpretation. All are opaque and transmit no sight, sound, spell/attack/sensor line, projectile, loose object, independent fluid or vehicle. Only creatures with their actually lawful carried goods/creatures can transit. No imported one-transit or 500-lb limit; actual capacity, fit and support remain mandatory.
procedure.NEW_sites: Select C02-A: A is a perceived supported local pose within 120 feet and caster line of effect on the actual current plane. B and C are exact personally known registered sites with genuine plane keys and portal poses. NEW remote selection has no geographic range ceiling, but require three pairwise distinct actual planes. Earned personal/site evidence and current legal poses must exist; rumor, Wheel labels, alignment, Heartcell theory or an invented plane/site cannot substitute. Missing endpoints are a whole-case hold/preflight rejection, not a license to populate the registry from schematic tests.
procedure.NEW_establishment: Validate all three complete aperture poses and required arrival spaces before payment and again at resolution. One cast, payment and counter window. Manifest A, then B, then C within one atomic resolution; no aperture is usable until all three complete. A hidden invalid endpoint defeats the entire establishment without refund or retargeting. One parent application and one active network per caster. New concentration ends an incompatible prior network at commitment even if the new cast fails. Deadline is successful network completion plus 60 seconds. Apertures have no physical HP or load-bearing body.
procedure.NEW_transit: Select C03-A: planar/extradimensional physical-gateway travel, NOT teleportation. Every edge crosses actual distinct planes. Test exact origin/destination blockers for every body in the whole group. Actual Dimensional Anchor blocks its matching endpoints; actual No Escape blocks its own voluntary extradimensional predicate, while teleport-only Verdict/Reign clauses do not automatically apply. No class feature or ward is acquired merely by citing it. Destination Planar Protection evaluates prospective actual origin before arrival; successful travel alone commits lastArrivedFromPlaneKey. No native-plane or soul fact follows.
procedure.NEW_crossing_transaction: Voluntary entry costs five feet of ordinary movement with real terrain/squeeze/crawl costs; approach remains ordinary movement. Independent lawful forced movement can cross only with five feet of actual remaining displacement and valid whole path/fit; it grants no extra force, consent immunity or action. Genuine squeezing permission is required, including height/anatomy. Revalidate the same complete body/cargo group. Preserve relative poses, rotate entry-forward to exit-front, and map lateral/vertical coordinates. Place the group immediately in front of the exit, using only the minimal front-normal offset needed for its entire volume and actual support. No adjacent safe-space search or alternative endpoint. A known illegal attempt spends no five-foot debit. A hidden/new failure after legal commitment spends the attempted movement/force cost but leaves every body/item at origin. Each later crossing requires a new real entry/cost; arrival never automatically loops through the cycle.
procedure.NEW_lifecycle: Select C06-A: local suppression of B disables A→B and B→C, leaving C→A only if both endpoints remain valid. Never reconnect A→C. No queued crossings; original deadline continues. Whole-parent removal/dispel, concentration loss/death/incapacity, dismissal, replacement or expiry closes all nodes. A legal already-resolving atomic crossing finishes before closure; no new crossing starts exactly at expiry. No split, ejection, recall or rewind of completed travel. Restored local expression keeps the original sites, graph and deadline.
